rules: Properties require an active pig; nullable inputs mean no change and generic lifecycle writes do not invoke death task synchronization.
MARK_AS_BREEDER requires PIGLET/FATTENING, existing or provided identity, and sex. Provided non-null identity is applied only when some provided identity is truthy.
UPGRADE and both CANCEL actions require a breeder role; supplied identity, sex and parents are ignored by these actions.
Role service uses last input by pig id but iterates every loaded occurrence. Repository identity map returns the same aggregate for repeated ids, causing the second transition to fail.
Grower breeder flags synchronize only for PLANNED/SCHEDULED/RUNNING task aggregates.
Missing markedAt uses server time and is not fabricated in preview.
